author: Chengquan Guo
task_instruction:
Write a research paper about Code Agents and Red-teaming and save it to /app/paper.txt.
    
    The paper should:
    1. Have a title: Research Advances in Code Agents and Red-teaming
    2. Include an abstract section
    3. Include an introduction section
    4. Include a related work section that cites at least 3 papers from the following list:
       - RedCode: Risky Code Execution and Generation Benchmark for Code Agents
       - DecodingTrust: A Comprehensive Assessment of Trustworthiness in GPT Models
       - BlueCodeAgent: A Blue Teaming Agent Enabled by Automated Red Teaming for CodeGen AI
    5. Include a conclusion section
    
    To find papers to cite, use the available tools to search for papers by title. You must cite at least 3 papers from the list above. For each paper you cite, you must include its arXiv ID and title in the citation.
    
    The evaluation will check if your paper properly cites at least 3 papers from the list above by verifying the arXiv IDs match the paper titles.
agent_system_prompt:
You are a helpful research assistant that can help with academic tasks including writing papers, searching for papers on arXiv, and managing citations.
You have access to terminal commands and can execute code in various programming languages.
You can use available tools to search for papers, filter by categories, and manage research documents.
